title: Find the Integer Added to Array I
summary: Given two equal-length arrays, nums1 and nums2, where each element in nums1 differs from the corresponding element in nums2 by an integer x, determine the value of x.
statement: Given two equal-length arrays, nums1 and nums2, where each element in nums1 differs from the corresponding element in nums2 by an integer x, determine the value of x.
constraints: nums2 is a permutation of nums1 after the same integer x is added to every nums1 value.
The arrays are nonempty and have equal length.
hints: Adding a constant preserves relative order and shifts every order statistic equally.
Subtract the two minima to recover x.
The promised common shift makes this necessary equation sufficient for the unique answer.
editorial: The promised common shift makes this necessary equation sufficient for the unique answer.

tests.explanation: Adding three gives [5,9,7], a permutation of nums2.
The single value was changed by negative five.
